messages.text: Hey, I'm driving over, do you know if there's any parking nearby?
I am not certain about parking availability. I would be happy to have the owner follow up with that information for you.
Could you check one more time? I really need to know if parking is an issue before I drive out.

I am not certain about parking availability. I can only provide information that is in our catalog, and parking details are not listed. I would be happy to have the owner follow up with that information for you.
Is there any public parking within walking distance at all?

I am not certain about parking availability, as this information is not listed in our catalog. I can only provide details regarding our menu and operating hours. I would be happy to have the owner follow up with that information for you.
